title: Fix n8n Expression Editor scroll-highlighting bug
description:
Source issue: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues/33746

Bug summary:
In n8n, the green Live Data highlighting in the Expression Editor disappears while scrolling in the expanded editor and in the Execution view. Typing temporarily restores it, which suggests a frontend rendering or synchronization bug rather than an expression-evaluation problem.

Scope:
- Reproduce the bug described in the GitHub issue.
- Identify the frontend root cause.
- Implement a fix so highlighting remains visible and synchronized while scrolling.
- Verify the fix in both the editor and execution surfaces mentioned in the report.

Acceptance criteria:
- Highlighting no longer disappears when scrolling either panel.
- The fix works in the full-screen Expression Editor and the Execution view.
- Share a short implementation note explaining the root cause and the files changed.
- Include clear reproduction / verification steps in the submission.

Submission expectations:
- Prefer a clean patch or PR-ready change set.
- Include any relevant screenshots or short screen recordings if helpful.
- If you cannot fully fix it, explain the blocker clearly and do not submit partial guesswork as complete.

Tech context:
This likely fits a TypeScript / React / frontend debugging workflow.
